properties.name: The v0.40.0 version bump. Only the version string moved; nothing this manifest describes behaves differently. The design meaning of a cut lives in the Release node and its epoch, not in a version string — so the design holds. Accepted BEFORE the manifest is frozen, so release_includes_all records the post-bump file rather than the pre-bump one (the ordering trap that cost a second export on earlier cuts).
